title: Comparative retinal pigment epithelium and photoreceptor ultrastructure in nocturnal and fossorial rodents: the eastern woodrat, Neotoma floridana and the plains pocket gopher, Geomys bursarius
why: Photoreceptor ultrastructure of Neotoma floridana; could say whether the retina holds cones as well as rods. Found only as a reference in Williams et al. 2004 (10.1007/s00359-004-0578-4); not opened and no DOI found.

title: Eye of the dragon: visual specializations of the Jacky dragon, Amphibolurus muricatus
why: Doctoral thesis on the Jacky dragon eye: schematic eye, retinal topography, pupil response. Its abstract (read) gives a deep fovea; the full text should hold the acuity method, field of view, pupil shape and photoreceptor types that the repository page does not show. The page offers no file link.
get: thesis via ANU Open Research (no file link on the repository page; ask the library)
